definition.title: Draft an embeddable score quiz
definition.description: Draft a self-contained scored quiz widget to paste onto your own site: a few questions about the visitor's situation, an instant verdict and a call to action. A free interactive tool is a lead magnet, not another article or email. Draft only; Tin never deploys it, and the widget makes no network calls.

human_review.summary: Review the quiz questions, scoring and copy before embedding it anywhere.

prerequisites.reason: The Feature map says what the product actually does, which grounds the quiz topic and the call to action.
The growth plan names the audience who should take the quiz.
The founder's writing style guide supplies the voice notes for the quiz copy.

product_name.title: Product name
product_name.description: The name customers know it by, as on the website or README.

quiz_topic.title: What the quiz scores
quiz_topic.description: The question a visitor wants answered about themselves, e.g. "is your API ready for production traffic". Pick a problem the product solves, from the Feature map in wiki/INDEX.md.

audience.title: Who should take it
audience.description: Who should take it, from the audience section of reports/GROWTH_ONBOARDING_PLAN.md when the project has one.

signup_url.title: Where the call to action sends people
signup_url.description: The product's real https:// signup, trial or waitlist page, from the website or codebase. It is the only link in the widget.

product_summary.title: Optional one-line product summary
product_summary.description: What the product does for this audience, in one or two sentences from the Feature map in wiki/INDEX.md or the README. The call to action never claims more than this.

voice_notes.title: Optional voice notes
voice_notes.description: A few concrete rules from the founder's style guide (.agents/skills/writing-style/SKILL.md): words to use or avoid, sentence length, emoji habits. Paraphrase; do not paste the whole guide.

nodes.label: Design the questions and bands
nodes.fact: one model call, 4 to 6 questions, 3 bands

nodes.label: Write the share and CTA lines
nodes.fact: one model call, no links of its own

nodes.label: Build the widget in code
nodes.fact: fixed HTML and JS, model text as data

nodes.label: Review the quiz
nodes.fact: no deadline, Tin never deploys it

nodes.label: Quiz ready to embed
nodes.fact: no network calls, one link to your signup
